observations: The top is unchanged for another day: Steal An Egg (93 days) leads ahead of Brookhaven, 99 Nights in the Forest, +1 Speed Keyboard Escape, Murder Mystery 2 and RIVALS.

combat_pvp (70), racing_driving (67), steal_defend_base (64) and roleplay_social (62) lead loops by median percentile, while wave survival (29), incremental_plus1 (31) and obbies (31) trail.

Long-running hits in the video set keep a light HUD in social and PvP games (Brookhaven, RIVALS, Adopt Me!) but a dense one in progression games (Blox Fruits, Hypershot), suggesting HUD density follows the loop rather than success.

te.pillar: Monetization Efficiency: earning a high position with modest CCU (Monetization Score ranks position × CCU, lower is better).
observations: Donation hubs (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS) lead efficiency again, followed by Elemental Dungeons, Spin a KPOP Idol and Dinosaur Simulator.
Efficiency still rises with age: 33rd median percentile at 15–42 days, 41 at 43–84, 53 at 85–122 and 59 past a year (H-te-001 at 81%).
Movement was minimal: only Skibi Defense entered, and the biggest fallers lost a single place.
Fake an Egg (22 days), Violence District, Bike For Egg! and DONT SPLASH are the weakest earners for their player counts.
patterns: A median developer product above 79 R$ consistently goes with higher efficiency (r=+0.38 at the split; H-te-005 at 82%).
RPGs (r=+0.47) and roleplay loops (r=+0.30) consistently earn more per player, while Survival (r=-0.30), Simulation (r=-0.20) and solo loops (r=-0.24) earn less.
Longer descriptions, more and pricier passes, bigger servers and higher complexity all consistently go with efficiency, with age as a shared confounder.
'Egg' (r=-0.70) and 'Steal' (r=-0.40) titles carry the lowest efficiency, and steal_defend_base sits at the 19th median percentile among loops.

summary: Physics sandboxes and horror lead both breakout charts: Ragdoll Reality and Realistic Ragdoll Engine sit high on Up-and-Coming and Top Trending, and horror_escape is now the largest loop on Up-and-Coming.
Games pull players first and monetize later: the youngest games lead Top Trending while Top Earning efficiency climbs from the 33rd percentile at 15–42 days to the 59th past a year.
Steal/egg templates keep buying reach without revenue: Steal An Egg leads Most Popular while Fake an Egg and Bike For Egg! are the weakest earners per player.
Halloween tags appear on most chart titles this week, a seasonal confounder for bracket-tag and update hypotheses.
progressions: uc→tt is now the most common transition (103 entries, median 2 days), just ahead of tt→mp (101, 2 days).
te→tt (67, 8 days), uc→te (66, 4 days), tt→te (65, 4 days) and uc→mp (64, 4 days) show breakouts reaching revenue and dominance within about a week, while tt→uc stays at 1.

evidence.rationale: Hollow-framed thumbnails now appear on Demonology (entered Top Trending) and Survive Overnight in a Mega Store (on Most Popular, though among its weakest); Violence District rose +16 on Most Popular. The lift continues, and Halloween still confounds it.

evidence.rationale: Ragdoll Reality (13 days) is second best on Up-and-Coming and among the best on Top Trending momentum; Realistic Ragdoll Engine (14 days) holds Up-and-Coming #9 and is on Top Trending. physics-sandbox loops lead both breakout charts by median percentile (85 and 87).
